proposals.expected_signal: Improved tail-item ranking and stronger top-10 separation versus plain pairwise ranking, with largest gains on users whose positives sit near high-degree distractors.
proposals.failure_mode: Auxiliary contrastive term may over-separate semantically adjacent items or destabilize optimization if hard negatives collapse onto false negatives.
proposals.hypothesis: Adding a degree-aware hard-negative contrastive auxiliary loss to a LightGCN backbone will sharpen local user-item discrimination beyond standard BPR while preserving the ML-1M full-sort protocol, yielding measurable NDCG@10 lift with moderate implementation risk.
